diffusion_D_um2_per_s.provenance: Typical morphogen effective diffusion ~0.1-10 um^2/s (e.g. Bicoid, FGF, Nodal): Kicheva et al. 2007 (Science); Yu et al. 2009. Central value; target-independent.

growth_alpha.provenance: Dosage(size supply) ~ (developmental time available)^alpha, single UNIVERSAL exponent applied to ALL organs identically (not per-organ). alpha=1 is the documented modelling choice; not tuned to any mass.

morphogen_decay_min.provenance: Morphogen clearance timescale ~tens of minutes-hours: Kicheva et al. 2007. Generic central value.

territory_theta.provenance: Activation threshold (fraction of steady state) at which a regulator is counted ON. Modelling choice; engine is required to be theta-robust over [0.3,0.7] (asserted in gate).

lambda_um.provenance: lambda = sqrt(D*tau); composed of two measured locked constants, no fit
